atoms.a:
Barry went to the bakery. He bought a loaf of bread for £1.34, a bacon bap for £1.19, a muffin for 89p and a pastry for 75p.

How much did Barry spend in total? Add up all the values in pence.

hint.text: Don’t forget to convert to pounds!

atoms.a:
Pia and Lena decide to make a stew. First they go to the greengrocer’s to get the vegetables. They buy carrots for £2.08, potatoes for £3.12, a leek for £1.19 and some parsnips for 65p.

How much do they spend in the greengrocer’s?

The girls then buy some meat in the butcher’s for £8.23.

How much have they spent all together?

atoms.b: In total, Pia and Lena spent £<mat><gap>15.27</gap></mat> on ingredients for the stew.
